title: Sell Mineral Rights in Wooster, AR
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Wooster, AR | Faulkner County
metaDescription: Wooster, AR sits in the core Fayetteville Shale acreage of Faulkner County. Get your mineral interest priced against real production and title records.
heroLead: Wooster is a small Faulkner County town that sat inside the busiest stretch of the Fayetteville Shale drilling program back when SEECO and XTO were running rigs through the county core.
intro: Faulkner County was one of the four original core counties of the play, and the ground around Wooster saw a heavy run of horizontal wells through the mid-2000s and into the following decade. Most of those wells are now well past their steepest decline, producing a fraction of what they did in their first year or two, which is exactly what you'd expect from a Fayetteville Shale well this far into its life.

sections.heading: What a Mature Well Means for Your Check
paragraphs: A shrinking royalty check from a Wooster-area well isn't unusual at this stage; it's the normal shape of the shale gas decline curve, steep early on and then flattening into a long, low-volume tail. The current base decline rate, not the size of the check alone, is what tells us how much production runway is realistically left.

sections.heading: Confirming Ownership Before We Price Anything
paragraphs: A fair number of Wooster interests passed through a family without the division order ever being formally updated, which can mean checks that don't match what the acreage should pay. We pull the lease, any pooling order, and probate records through the Faulkner County Circuit Clerk before quoting a number, so the offer reflects your actual documented share.

faqs.question: How is a Wooster-area well different from a brand-new well elsewhere?
faqs.answer: Age and decline stage. Most Faulkner County Fayetteville Shale wells, including those near Wooster, are years past their peak and now producing at a steady, lower rate, which is what we price against.

faqs.question: What if my division order doesn't match how many heirs actually own the interest now?
faqs.answer: That's common on older Wooster tracts. We help reconcile it using probate records or affidavits of heirship before closing a sale.

faqs.question: Do you buy interests that are still leased to an active operator?
faqs.answer: Yes, an active lease and ongoing production is generally what makes an interest easiest to price and close quickly.

faqs.question: What's the fastest way to get a real number for my Wooster mineral interest?
faqs.answer: Send a recent royalty statement or division order if you have one. Without it, we can pull the equivalent records ourselves from Faulkner County and Arkansas Oil and Gas Commission filings.
